status: Exploratory continuation after earlier historical audits; fixed before scoring models on the repaired data, not public preregistration or untouched confirmation
question: Does recovering genuine common monthly weather and transferring source-learned partitions yield value beyond equal-budget local models?
target: Existing 2000-2024 unweighted SatPM FUA-month means, unchanged labels
feature_ablation: All sets share six weather variables, hemisphere-aligned season, population density, coast distance, urban-centre share and contemporaneous fire context. Legacy repeats annual values and carries 2022 into 2023-2024; updated annual uses the correct annual values; monthly common uses actual months; aviation adds the original observations and availability fields without overwriting reanalysis.
target_fitting: Every evaluated month uses only the preceding W months of the ten development FUAs. No current-month labels or held-FUA labels enter fitting.
negative_control: Same source LightGBM settings with a fixed random permutation of source labels; target labels refit the resulting partition kernel. This is a shuffled-source-label control, not a literal no-source-data learner.
partition_kernel: Normalized one-hot source leaf membership yields the fraction of shared terminal leaves; center the kernel on the target fitting rows and fit KernelRidge. Existing LightGBM and scikit-learn supply core logic. Inspired by random-partition kernels, not a claimed replication of SER/STRUT or RSD.
gate_rule: Zero, one or two inequalities using discovery-predictor quantiles [.1,.25,.5,.75,.9]; pairs from the top twelve single rules. Calibration similarity is the maximum source-leaf agreement with earlier target fitting rows.
gate_choice: Discovery RMSE reduction >=5% against every local comparator and the shuffled-source control, positive in both discovery years against the discovery-selected comparator; prefer fewer conditions, greater coverage, then greater gain. If none qualify retain the best unrestricted failed candidate.
minimum_support: At least 25% of all target rows and all target FUAs, at least 5 FUAs and 12 months; rejected samples remain in the denominator.
replication: Frozen model/rule, discovery passed, >=5% RMSE reduction against all four local comparators and the shuffled-source control, support criteria, and positive paired-bootstrap lower bounds against the frozen comparator, target mean and shuffled-source control in both confirmation and other-city audit.
bootstrap: 1000 paired cross-cluster replicates; both FUA x calendar-quarter and shared POWER grid x calendar-quarter clusters must support the improvement. Exploratory, not post-selection guarantees.
shared_grid_sensitivity: Also report the 2023-2024 other-FUA subset whose POWER grid was not used by development cities; do not reselect rules on this subset.
